name: invoicetap
description: InvoiceTap monorepo — quotes, invoices, receipts, payments and WhatsApp delivery for freelancers and small businesses.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@invoicetap/api & npm run dev --workspace=@invoicetap/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/shared && npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/ui && npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/database && npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/api && npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/shared && npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/database && npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/shared && npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/ui && npm run build --workspace=@invoicetap/web
